## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
lib/zaq/channels/email_bridge.ex and email_bridge/smtp_sender.ex. Carry trusted context, prepare all files once around existing deliver_email_reply, compose Swoosh attachments, preserve explicit SMTP connector/recipient/thread headers. Retain resources until synchronous Mailer return.

## Tests to add before implementation
Existing email/SMTP tests: exact binary bytes, multiple files, MIME/filename, malformed internal payload, preparation failure sends nothing, SMTP rejection, sender/recipients/headers and resources live through consumption.

## Branches/paths validated
Zero, one and multiple files; one preparation failure prevents email send; actual sender/recipient receipt; generic and explicit provider error preserved.

## Mocking plan
Existing Swoosh test boundary for composition and external SMTP edge failures; real SMTP receiver in E2E. No global adapter/config replacement.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Keep affected module docs accurate. Coordinate the final docs/services/channels.md update and update this issue with evidence/decisions; follow documentation hygiene.

## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing bridge and sender; reuse Swoosh.Attachment/Mailer and selected connector path. Only prepared values reach SMTP helper; no direct paths or URLs from untrusted user payloads and no second materialization.

## Constraints and validation
Read parent settled decisions and applicable repository service, tool-routing, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Preserve current test behavior. Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.
